candidates.title: A Scheduling Framework for Efficient MoE Inference on Edge GPU-NDP Systems
candidates.reason: Combines expert tensor parallelism, GPU/NDP load-balancing and dataset-free prefetch for low-batch edge MoE inference; distinct heterogeneous scheduling design.
